question: What consequence follows from daily abstention from food in this practice?
premises: Death associated with age is named.
inference: Through daily abstention from food, one will go to the death of old age.
uncertainties: The exact sense of vayo mṛtyuṃ gamiṣyate is ambiguous; it may mean overcoming or reaching death by aging.
plain_english: By daily abstention from food, one will go to the death of old age.
